company.name: All About Vending (VIC)
company.distributes: Snack vending with healthy bars, chocolate, snacks, biscuits and sugar-free options, plus Asian snacks and fresh food vending
company.channels_supplied: Independent unattended retail operator placing and restocking machines at Melbourne sites
company.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free options and Better for you stickers in its healthy range; brands not named
what_they_do_well: Delivering convenience in Melbourne since 2008.
Runs a healthy vending programme with traffic light labelling and better for you stickers.
company.fit_rationale: An independent Melbourne unattended retail operator trading since 2008 that runs a healthy vending programme with traffic light labels, better for you stickers and sugar-free options across bars, chocolate and biscuits. Diablo sugar-free chocolate and biscuits match that programme directly. Storage: sells from its own stock in its machines, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: C&C Vending Services
company.distributes: Chocolate bars, lollies, protein bars, chips, popcorn and nuts in its own snack, combo and healthy vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Workplaces, warehouses, schools and gyms across Greater Sydney, the Central Coast and the Blue Mountains
company.sf_brands_carried: Healthy vending machines and school ranges set to school health and food policy; no brand named
what_they_do_well: Over 10 years supplying snacks and drinks to Sydney workplaces, with machines alerting it in real time when stock runs low.
company.fit_rationale: A Sydney operator that refills its own fully managed machines with chocolate bars, lollies and protein bars, three of Diablo's categories. Its healthy machines and school ranges suit sugar-free chocolate and bars. Brands stocked are not named on its website. Storage: own warehouse in Rouse Hill.

company.name: CERES Fair Food
company.distributes: Organic groceries including chocolate (Atypic, Cocoa Rhapsody, Daintree Estates, Koko Black, Monsieur Truffe), biscuits, cakes and muffins (Dench), granola bars (Adelia), marshmallows and savoury snacks
company.channels_supplied: Online grocery with home delivery to Melbourne households
company.sf_brands_carried: The Carob Kitchen carob bars with no added sugar; no direct sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Sources from nearly 200 organic growers and makers for its Melbourne home deliveries.
All profits go to CERES, a registered charity growing organic food.
company.fit_rationale: A Melbourne not-for-profit online grocer whose own shop has chocolate, snacks and treats, and biscuits and cakes categories filled with other companies' brands. Its health-minded organic shoppers suit Diablo's vegan muesli bars, peanut butters and jams and its no-added-sugar chocolate. It runs its own Fair Food warehouse and next-day delivery.

company.name: COS (Complete Office Supplies)
company.distributes: Kitchen and catering range with biscuits and crackers, snack bars and healthy snacks for workplaces
company.channels_supplied: Next-day delivery to more than 250,000 business, government and education customers across Australia
company.sf_brands_carried: Low carb snack bars (MyMC salted caramel bar listed)
what_they_do_well: Trading for over 45 years with next-day delivery to over 250,000 customers across Australia.
company.fit_rationale: Large family-owned office supplier whose web shop sells biscuits, crackers and snack bars from other brands into office kitchens, with a healthy snacks offer. Storage: Brisbane branch and warehouse at Acacia Ridge, with next-day delivery.

company.name: Decathlon Australia
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Sports equipment with a protein bars and snacks section: protein bars and low carb bars from Body Science, Carman's and Optimum Nutrition
company.channels_supplied: Own stores in Melbourne (Box Hill South and Knoxfield among them) and its own online shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Low carb, high protein bars (Body Science High Protein Low Carb Bar)
what_they_do_well: Opened two Melbourne stores, in Box Hill South and Knoxfield, in east Melbourne.
company.fit_rationale: A big box sports chain with Melbourne stores and its own protein bars and snacks category stocked with other brands. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars suit the health-conscious shoppers it already serves.

company.name: Gift Linx
company.distributes: Corporate gift boxes with branded chocolate (Cuvee), nougat bars (Noogaa), rocky road (Charlotte Piper), fudge (House of Fudge) and popcorn, plus wine, drinkware and branded merchandise
company.channels_supplied: Corporate clients in Brisbane and Queensland, with delivery Australia-wide
what_they_do_well: Offers curation, design and branded merchandise for corporate gift boxes delivered Australia-wide.
company.fit_rationale: A Brisbane-focused corporate gifting company whose Sweet Temptation box is built entirely from other companies' branded chocolate and confectionery. It sources from Australian small businesses, so Diablo would be one of few imported lines; the brand list shows it buys finished, branded packs. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Good Day People
company.distributes: Gift hampers with other brands' chocolate (Bahen & Co, Hey Tiger, Wondaree chocolate macadamias), chocolate hazelnut spread (Messina), rocky road, Easter chocolate and sweet hampers
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop with same-day Sydney metro delivery and Australia-wide shipping; corporate gift boxes
company.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free treat options offered in its dietary hampers (brands not named)
what_they_do_well: Founded by a Sydney couple and featured in Concrete Playground and Urban List Christmas hamper guides.
Offers dietary gift hampers including gluten-free, vegan and sugar-free options.
company.fit_rationale: A Sydney-founded online gift hamper store whose sweet hampers combine chocolate, spreads and sweets from other Australian brands. It already offers dietary and sugar-free hampers, so Diablo's no-added-sugar chocolate and spreads fill a stated need.

company.name: Gottis
company.distributes: Imported Swedish sweets and gummies (pick and mix, jelly sweets, foam sweets, liquorice) from brands such as BUBS and Ahlgrens, plus pre-mixed sweets bags and tubs.
company.channels_supplied: Its own sweet shop in Hawthorn, its online shop shipping Australia-wide and pick and mix supply to other resellers.
what_they_do_well: Imports Swedish sweets directly and supplies full pick and mix stands to other resellers.
company.fit_rationale: Hawthorn sweet shop and online store that imports Swedish branded sweets such as BUBS and Ahlgrens and sells them to shoppers, and it also supplies pick and mix stands to other shops through its wholesale offer. It already brings a European confectionery brand into Melbourne, which suits Diablo's gummies and jelly sweets.

company.name: i Select Vending
company.distributes: Snacks and chocolate in its own snack and combo vending machines, with a super healthy package option
company.channels_supplied: Sydney businesses, with sales and service offices Sydney-wide
company.sf_brands_carried: A super healthy product package; no sugar-free brand named
what_they_do_well: Over 30 years serving Sydney businesses with vending machines and weekly free replenishment.
company.fit_rationale: A long-standing Sydney operator that replenishes its own machines with snacks and chocolate weekly at no charge to the client. Its healthy package gives Diablo's chocolate and bars a place. Brands stocked are not named on its website. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: iGift Hampers
company.distributes: Gift hampers and Easter and Christmas gifts with branded chocolate (Lindt Lindor, Ferrero Rocher, Baci, Cocoa Emperor), chocolate thins, biscuits, sweets and candy sections
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop; delivery across Greater Sydney, Central Coast, Wollongong, Blue Mountains and NSW; corporate hampers for Sydney businesses
what_they_do_well: Hand packing and delivering gift hampers across Australia since 2014.
Delivers corporate hampers for Sydney businesses, from single client gifts to hundreds of staff hampers.
company.fit_rationale: A Sydney hamper retailer with its own biscuits and sweets and candy categories that packs other brands' chocolates into seasonal and corporate hampers. Diablo's chocolate boxes, biscuits and advent calendars give it a no-added-sugar option for Easter, Christmas and corporate orders.

company.name: LVLY
company.distributes: Gift boxes with sweets and chocolate: assorted lolly boxes, chocolate bars (Party Time), Gourmet Wagon Wheel biscuits, Sweet Mickie cookies and chocolate almonds, sold with flowers and gifts.
company.channels_supplied: Its own online gift shop with same-day delivery in Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane and Perth and next-day delivery elsewhere in Australia.
what_they_do_well: Grew revenue from about 3.8 million to 13.9 million dollars in a year, per SmartCompany Smart50 2021.
company.fit_rationale: Melbourne-headquartered gifting company whose sweet gift boxes resell other brands' sweets, biscuits and chocolate, such as Wagon Wheel, Party Time and Sweet Mickie. Its same-day delivery network puts packaged treats in front of gift buyers in Melbourne every day, and gift boxes and variety packs match Diablo's gifting range.

company.name: Office National
company.distributes: Canteen and kitchen supplies with biscuits and snacks: Arnott's and Lotus biscuits in bulk, standard and portion packs
company.channels_supplied: Network of about 180 locally owned office supply stores, including Brisbane area members, with online ordering
what_they_do_well: Network of about 180 Office National locations across Australia since 1999.
company.fit_rationale: National office supplies network owned by Office Brands whose online shop carries branded biscuits and snacks for workplace kitchens, reaching Brisbane through local member stores. Storage: B2B web shop with stock and prices; warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Peter's of Kensington
company.distributes: Gourmet food and Christmas food department selling branded chocolates (Walkers Chocolates, M and B Chocolates, Tartufo) and Christmas hampers alongside gifts and kitchenware
company.channels_supplied: Own Sydney stores (including Birkenhead Point) and its online shop
what_they_do_well: Sells European chocolate brands such as Walkers Chocolates and Tartufo in its own gourmet food section.
company.fit_rationale: A long-established Sydney gift and homewares retailer with a gourmet food and Christmas food department that stocks other brands' chocolates and hampers. Diablo's chocolate boxes and seasonal gift packs suit its Christmas and gifting shelves. Store count not stated on the pages checked.

company.name: Purely Gourmet
company.distributes: Gift hampers including chocolate and sweet hampers, Easter chocolate hampers and biscuits from brands such as Byron Bay Cookie Company and Charlie's Fine Food Co., with Mischief chocolates
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online with same day Melbourne delivery, and corporate and custom branded hampers for HR teams, real estate, law and financial firms
what_they_do_well: Runs a purpose-built fulfilment warehouse in Keysborough with sales offices in four capital cities.
Same day hamper delivery in Melbourne.
company.fit_rationale: A family run Melbourne hamper company with a dedicated chocolate and sweet hamper range built from other brands' chocolate and biscuits, sold to corporate teams and shoppers. Sales offices in Sydney, Brisbane and Adelaide widen its reach beyond Melbourne. Storage: purpose-built fulfilment warehouse at Naxos Way, Keysborough.

company.name: SOM Vending
company.distributes: Confectionery including chocolates, protein bars and sweet treats, cookies, chips, instant noodles, soft drinks and energy drinks
company.channels_supplied: Free vending machines delivered, serviced and restocked for businesses in metro and regional Victoria and Western Australia
company.sf_brands_carried: Diet cola; no sugar-free confectionery brand named
what_they_do_well: Covers all of metro and regional Victoria plus Western Australia with free delivery, servicing and restocking.
company.fit_rationale: SOM Vending supplies machines free, then services and restocks them itself with branded chocolates, protein bars and cookies across metro Melbourne and regional Victoria. Diablo bars and cookies add a sugar-free choice to an existing confectionery slot. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Spotlight
company.distributes: Party and Christmas confectionery: sweets, lollies and chocolate for lolly bags and candy buffets, from brands such as Allen's, Chupa Chups, Lolliland and The Natural Confectionery Co, alongside craft, fabric, homewares and party goods.
company.channels_supplied: Its own Spotlight stores (146 listed in 2026) and its online shop.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1973 and headquartered in South Melbourne, with 146 Spotlight stores listed.
company.fit_rationale: Melbourne-headquartered craft, party and seasonal retailer with a confectionery section in its party department and a Christmas lollies and confectionery category, stocked with other companies' brands. Its Christmas and party trade makes it a seasonal gift destination with national reach from its Melbourne head office. Store count from Wikipedia: 146 Spotlight stores.

company.name: VendWorks
company.distributes: Chocolate, lollies, chips and snack packs, protein snacks, drinks and fresh food in fully managed vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Warehouses, manufacturing sites, gyms, offices, hotels, hospitals, education, government, retail centres and apartment complexes in Melbourne
company.sf_brands_carried: Low-sugar, high-protein and plant-based options; brands not named
what_they_do_well: Helped a client implement Victorian Government Healthy Eating Guidelines in its vending.
company.fit_rationale: A Melbourne smart vending operator whose fully managed machines carry chocolate, lollies and protein snacks, with low-sugar and plant-based options for healthy eating sites. A client credits it with meeting Victorian Government Healthy Eating Guidelines, where Diablo sugar-free sweets and bars help. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
